description: Use after search_archive, whats_new or what_changed to read one record in full: title, dates, source URLs, topics and body text. Pass the newruntime.com URL you got, or kind + slug. Free, no auth. Example: {"url": "https://newruntime.com/signals/<slug>/"}.
name: get_record

record.description: The published record: title, dates, source_urls, topics, entities, body and routes.

truncated.description: Present and true when body/markdown were dropped to fit the size cap; read the url for the full text.

url.description: Canonical newruntime.com URL of the record.

title: Read one New Runtime record
